details.biography:
The Broken Anvil · Level 1 - The Recruits · Seat 2, Skirmisher

A sharp-eyed halfling scavenger from the edge of the Red Waste who can vanish behind a cactus and shoot you from behind it. Quick, suspicious and always counting: coins, exits, goblins, and how many sausages are left in the pack. Grew up picking through wrecked caravans on the Waste's edge; the Keepers pay on time, and nobody has ever paid Tansy on time.

In a fight

Stay hidden and shoot from cover for Sneak Attack (+2d6), or creep behind a distracted goblin and Back Attack it with a dagger.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities (from the printed sheet)

Sneak Attack. Once per round, against an aware but unsuspecting target within 30ft (60ft in natural terrain, see kit): Advantage on the attack and +1d6 damage (+2d6 with Predator). Unsuspecting = it cannot see you, has not yet acted this encounter, or is in melee with one of your allies and not with you. No stealth check needed. Cannot combine with Back Attack.

Back Attack. Once per round. Needs a successful Move Silently or Hide check, attacking from behind a target with a discernible back, using a close-quarters weapon shorter than your arm (your dagger). Advantage on the attack and double the weapon's damage dice only (dagger 2d4+4).

Precise Strikes. +1 damage on every weapon hit (already in your attack lines).

Hide and Move Silently. Normal roll at half speed or less, Disadvantage above half speed, impossible while running or charging. You may Hide while only lightly obscured. You cannot attempt both together until 3rd level. Hide = Dex check against each watcher's Wisdom check (or 10 + its Wis mod if it is not looking). Listening through a solid barrier has Disadvantage.

Rogue Skills. Climb (Dex). Open Locks (Dex): one try per lock until you gain a level. Pick Pocket (Dex): DC 10 + the target's Level. Find/Disable/Set Trap (Int). Decipher Script (Int): 2d8 minutes a page; arcane script is a Hard (DC 15) check and you cannot cast it; never works on divine scrolls.

Waste-Born Stillness (kit). Advantage on Hide checks in wilderness or natural terrain, and there your Sneak Attack range is 60ft instead of 30ft.

Ghost of the Sands (kit). Advantage on checks to evade tracking in harsh terrain.

Small. Speed 25ft, no darkvision. Advantage on Move Silently and stealth checks, and on checks to escape a grapple or Restrained. Disadvantage with Heavy weapons.

Lucky. On a natural 1 on an attack, check or save, reroll and take the new result, up to 3 times per session.

Nimble. You can move through the space of any larger creature.

Brave Heart. Once per long rest, before you roll a save, gain Advantage on it (burn 1 Luck for an extra use).

Green Thumb. Advantage on checks about farming, foraging or identifying plants.

Weapon training. Sling, shortsword, dagger, handaxe.

Predator (Specialist, Rogue 1st-level feat). Advantage on Stealth checks, and your Sneak Attack deals +1d6 (included: 2d6 total).

Notes. Speed: 25ft · Initiative: +3 · HP: d6 max (6) + Con mod (+2) = 8. Untrained NWPs are rolled with Disadvantage; everyday checks (notice, climb, intimidate) are plain attribute checks.

Armour Class on the sheet: 10 + 3 (Studded Leather, Light) + 3 (Dex, full) = 16

Class Abilities

1st Level

  • Cant — a coded thieves' language
  • Climb (Dexterity)
  • Decipher Script (Intelligence): 2d8 minutes per page; arcane script is a Hard check to read (you cannot cast it); never works on divine scrolls
  • Open Locks (Dexterity): one attempt per lock until you gain a level
  • Pick Pocket (Dexterity): DC 10 + the target's Level
  • Find/Disable/Set Trap (Intelligence)

Back Attack

  • Effect: Advantage on the attack roll plus a damage multiplier (double at 1st level, rising to sextuple at 20th — see the Rogue Progression Table).
  • Usable once per round.
  • Requires a successful Move Silently or Hide check, attacking from behind a target with a discernible back, using a close-quarters melee weapon shorter than your arm.
  • Multiply the weapon's damage dice only.

Sneak Attack

  • Effect: Advantage on the attack roll plus a scaling damage die (1d6 at 1st level, rising to 4d6 at 23rd — see the Rogue Progression Table) against an aware-but-unsuspecting target, once per round.
  • Usable at range within 30ft, doesn't require a prior stealth check, can't combine with Back Attack.
  • A target is unsuspecting if it cannot see you, has not yet acted this encounter, or is in melee with one of your allies and not with you.

Precise Strikes

  • Effect: Your weapon attacks deal +1 damage per three Rogue levels (minimum +1). This applies to every hit, not only Sneak Attacks.

Hide and Move Silently

  • Effect: Normal roll at half speed or under, disadvantage above half speed, impossible to attempt while running or charging. You count as Hidden while lightly obscured even on a result of 12 to 14.
  • Listen: disadvantage when listening through any solid barrier

2nd Level

Cunning Step

  • Effect: Once per round, you may move away from a creature in melee reach without provoking opportunity attacks.

Hit and Run

  • Effect: On a turn you make an attack, your speed increases by 10ft (20ft from 13th level). Once per round, you can move through one enemy's space. Moving through that space doesn't provoke Attacks of Opportunity.

3rd Level

  • Attempting Hide and Move Silently together imposes Disadvantage on both checks, at quarter speed

Detect Secret/Concealed Doors

  • Effect: Advantage on checks to find secret or concealed doors, plus a free check whenever you pass within 10ft of one.

4th Level

Evasive Manoeuvre

  • Effect: The first melee attack against you each round has Disadvantage. It doesn't work in a round you make a ranged attack or use another rogue ability, or while you are surprised.
  • 20th level: the first two melee attacks against you each round have Disadvantage

5th Level

Uncanny Dodge

  • Effect: Once per round, when an attacker you can see hits you, halve the damage.

6th Level

Skill Mastery

  • Effect: Treat any d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10 when using your Rogue Skills.

7th Level

Evasion

  • Effect: When you succeed on a Reflex save against an effect that deals half damage on a success, you take none. If you fail, you take half.

Extra Attack

  • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex). Sneak Attack still applies to only one attack per round.

8th Level

  • Sixth Sense: Advantage on checks to avoid being surprised

9th Level

Dirty Fighting

  • Effect: Advantage on Dirty Trick, Disarm and Trip contests (see Combat Manoeuvres in The Arneyan Codex), and you may use Dexterity for Disarm.

15th Level

  • Dexterity Bonus: permanent +1 Dexterity

17th Level

  • The disadvantage from moving fast while hiding or moving silently is removed entirely

18th Level

  • Quick Reflexes: +1 to initiative

24th Level

  • Hide and Move Silently are fully unpenalised even while running or charging

Quick Reflexes (Improved)

  • Effect: +2 to initiative. Once per encounter, take one extra action in the first round — one additional attack or half movement.

Kits: Arneyan Thief Cultures

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Rogue folder. Drag one onto your character.

Rogue Kits represent the network, upbringing, or tradition that shaped the character's criminal trade.
